newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Two missing after shipwreck off Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Two missing after shipwreck off Morocco.

text.p: Two people were missing after a fishing vessel sank off the Moroccan coastal city of Larache in bad weather, the Moroccan fisheries ministry said on Monday.
The ministry said four people were rescued from the Yasser vessel after the accident occured on Friday night.
The ministry said its rescue ship also rescued another fishing boat in difficulties in the Atlantic the same night and towed it to port.
Rescue squad are on stand-by in most ports because of bad weather.
Heavy rains in recent weeks have killed six people, caused 43 houses and four bridges to collapse and cut 59 roads, according to Interior Minister Driss Basri.
